title: Unclear and never cleared: 'how much for the 60'
demonstrates: Rule R13, the session that ends unclear. The assistant asks one plain question, then offers two readings from the price list, then offers a way out (a name and a number, or come back when he knows). It never guesses. The customer stops answering; with no number there is no hand-off, the chat stays the assistant's, and Chatwoot resolves it after seven silent days with no person on the event.

scenario.who_writes: Somebody passing on what a friend told him.
scenario.what_happens: Three customer lines, three answers, no result.

the 60K scheduled maintenance of the catalogue

unclear.how: The assistant asks what he means; he repeats himself. It offers the two things on the price list that fit; he does not know. It asks for the friend's word or a number to pass on, and he does not answer.

timeline.text: Hi! I'm the assistant for Brennan Auto Care. Happy to help. What do you mean by "the 60", and what kind of car is it?
the 60 thing. my buddy said yall do it

Thanks. So I give you the right price, which of these is it: balancing four wheels, which is $60.00, or the 60,000-mile scheduled maintenance service, which is $243.00? If it's something else, tell me what the car needs or what it's doing.
No problem. If you can find out from him which service it was, or tell me what the car is doing, I can give you a price. Or leave your name and a number and I'll ask an advisor to call you.

state_at_t.resolved_how: by Chatwoot after 7 silent days; no person, no hand-off, no card

reads_back.operator_credit: nobody: the assistant is not an operator

truth.outcome: ended unclear; resolved by 7 silent days
facts: the request was never made clear
the assistant asked, offered two readings from the price list (60.00 and 243.00) and did not guess
no name or number was left, so no hand-over was made

why: Both readings are real rows of the price list: a wheel balance is 60.00 and there is a 60,000-mile service.
The assistant stays on the question and names no job as his.
This is one of the three sessions in a hundred that end unclear.
